'''The Fifty Treaty of Falme''' was a short-lived peace treaty between [[Arad Doman]] and [[Tarabon]]. It was brokered with the help of [[Merana Ambrey]] in {{ne|961}}. The treaty concerned the land known as [[Almoth Plain]] but was broken shortly after it was signed. Merana considers it her only real failure as an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Falme, Fifth Treaty of}}{{ref/book|6|43}}
